title: Slock Runtime Manifest
description: Local runtime manifest for Slock daemon bridge runtimes (SARP/1). Default location: <slockDir()>/runtimes.json (override via SLOCK_RUNTIME_MANIFEST). This schema is an authoring aid — packages/daemon/src/agent-runtime-manifest.ts (validateEntry) is the authoritative validator and is fail-closed. NOTE: secret VALUES never appear in this file; secretEnv names resolve from the daemon process environment and secretRefs names resolve from the local daemon-side secret store.

envName.description: Environment variable NAME only — never a value. Names beginning with SLOCK_ (case-insensitive), dangerous injection keys (NODE_OPTIONS, PYTHONPATH, LD_PRELOAD, DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES) are rejected by the validator.

id.description: Stable entrypoint identifier; unique within the manifest.

runtime.description: Bridge runtime family. Claude is the built-in default and is NOT declared here.

label.description: Human display label (safe to surface in server metadata).

command.description: Executable name (resolved on PATH) or absolute path. Shell operators are rejected — the daemon never invokes a shell.

cwd.description: Absolute working directory for the worker process.

env.description: Plain (non-secret) env for the worker. Rejected names: SLOCK_* (any case), dangerous injection keys, and credential-like names (…TOKEN/SECRET/PASSWORD/PASS/API_KEY/PRIVATE_KEY/ACCESS_KEY/CLIENT_SECRET…). Never put secret values here.

secretEnv.description: Env NAMES resolved from the daemon process environment at spawn/probe time. Values are never stored in the manifest.

secretRefs.description: Env NAMES resolved from the local daemon-side secret store (<slockDir()>/runtime-secrets.json, mode 0600) at spawn/probe time. Manage via `slock runtime secret set|unset|list`. Must not overlap env or secretEnv names (case-insensitive).

mcpToolAllowlist.description: Optional allowlist of platform MCP tool names (e.g. send_message, read_history) exposed to this entrypoint's worker. Sent to the SDK via initialize.platform.mcp.allowTools AND enforced in the platform MCP server (SLOCK_MCP_TOOL_ALLOWLIST). Omit/empty = all tools. NOT a permission boundary — real authorization stays with scoped tokens / server policy.

mode.description: fixed: only `default` is used. select: callers may choose from `allowed`.

allowed.description: Required (non-empty, must contain `default`) when mode=select; ignored for fixed.

requireDurableThreads.description: LangGraph: require checkpoint-backed durable threads (resume after restart).

silenceTimeoutMs.description: Max silence during a turn before the worker is declared stuck.
